faq.title: Before you start
faq.intro: Short answers to what clients ask us most.

items.q: What's the difference between regular design and BIM?
items.a: With BIM we build a 3D digital model of the building, and every drawing and quantity comes out of it. A change updates every sheet, so there are fewer errors and less waste on site.

items.q: Do you supervise construction or only design?
items.a: Both. You can ask for design only, or design plus supervision through handover.

items.q: Which cities do you work in?
items.a: We're based in Najaf with projects in Baghdad and other provinces. Design work can be done remotely anywhere in Iraq.

items.q: Do you design interiors room by room?
items.a: Yes. Every space is designed on its own: living room, bedrooms, majlis and kitchen, with ceiling, lighting and electrical plans.

items.q: What should I send to get started?
items.a: The plot location, area and dimensions, the number of floors and rooms you need, and photos of designs you like if you have them.

cta.title: Have a plot or a project idea?
cta.text: Send the location and area on WhatsApp, and we'll come back with a first take and a clear work plan.
